purpose: Goal-level registry of durable results and open obligations. Row-level proof details remain authoritative in docs/theory/PROOF_LEDGER.md.

claims.title: Connected unmarked Sturmian factor problem
claims.statement: For a computably presented nonempty aperiodic planar FLC tiling system S, determine whether a connected unmarked polygonal disk P exists with a total finite-radius translation-equivariant map from X(P) to X(S); alternatively prove nonexistence or undecidability for a clearly defined realization family.
claims.scope: Full Euclidean tilings by one connected unmarked polygon; totality is required on every admitted tiling, not only an intended image.
claims.novelty_status: open research question; no repository solution claimed

claims.title: Total local decoding and period descent
claims.statement: A nonempty finite local-rule tiling system with a total translation-equivariant finite-radius map to an aperiodic target is itself aperiodic; checking the decoder only on the intended encoded image is insufficient.
claims.scope: Full local closure of the source tiling system.
claims.novelty_status: standard compact symbolic-dynamics principle; no novelty claim

claims.title: Root-deterministic finite carriers are periodic
claims.statement: Every nonempty finite root-deterministic Z^2 carrier has a finite translation orbit and is periodic, so it cannot factor equivariantly to an aperiodic target.
claims.scope: Finite symbolic carriers in which one rooted state determines the entire configuration.
claims.novelty_status: standard finite-orbit argument; no novelty claim

claims.title: Marked connected-polygon Sturmian realization is undecidable
claims.statement: Tileability together with a specified total local factor to the fixed AHI source is undecidable for a computable family consisting of one connected polygon plus finite edge-to-edge matching rules.
claims.scope: Marked stick/polyhex support with a finite edge relation; this does not cover one unmarked polygon.
claims.novelty_status: standard product reduction; no novelty claim
claims.condition: Depends on the all-tilings weave converse in the unrefereed preprint stade-two-tiling-2025.

claims.title: Independent two-participant erasure classification
claims.statement: A finite directed relation admits a complete independent two-participant polygonal collar erasure exactly when its bipartite compatibility graph is a disjoint union of bicliques.
claims.scope: Relation-exact, uniquely rooted complete ports, disjoint collars, and exactly two participants.
claims.novelty_status: familiar jigsaw-color principle stated as a classification; no novelty claim

claims.title: Ordinary and torsion-free additive parity no-go
claims.statement: Neither an ordinary participant-separable sector star nor any finite family of participant-wise additive tests in a two-torsion-free abelian group can distinguish ternary even parity from the full binary cube.
claims.scope: Fixed topology and multiplicity, full unary/binary projections, no independently visible hidden star state or non-ordinary contact hyperedge.
claims.novelty_status: elementary algebraic obstruction; novelty not established

claims.title: Rooted hidden-state T-junctions realize finite relations
claims.statement: Every finite automaton and every finite fixed-arity relation has a rooted three-participant T-junction contact complex whose legal covers are exactly its accepted words or tuples.
claims.scope: Colored or role-labelled unit sides with prescribed rooted host, order, alignment, participant count and hidden finite state; not a one-unmarked-polygon theorem.
claims.novelty_status: standard finite-state construction; no novelty claim

claims.title: Polykite funnel inside the published classified range
claims.statement: The repository's n<=16 polykite funnel is a reproduction/control inside the published n<=24 exhaustive horizon and cannot support a discovery claim.
claims.scope: Kite-grid polykites; exact repository enumeration and bounded filters.

claims.title: Turtle exact-computation control
claims.statement: The legacy finalist is exactly the published Turtle; the finite period, patch, diffraction and holonomy results are retained as exact controls and not as a new tile or independent aperiodicity proof.
claims.scope: Repository Turtle geometry and the stated finite budgets only.
claims.novelty_status: known tile; control and reproduction only

claims.title: Spectre finite-language reconstruction control
claims.statement: The W3 artifacts reconstruct finite local Spectre languages, interfaces and conditional parent closure exactly, but reproduce published hierarchy methods and do not establish a new general certificate method.
claims.scope: Fixed-chirality edge-to-edge straight-Spectre model and the finite/conditional domains stated in the ledger.

claims.title: Exact AHI Section 10.1 source presentation
claims.statement: The pinned AHI Section 10.1 source is reconstructed as exact 30,30,2 primitive-triangle supports, 15,15,1 rhombus components, 31 addressed roles and a twelve-state corridor quotient.
claims.scope: The chosen beta=sqrt(2)-1 Section 10.1 construction only.
claims.novelty_status: exact source reconstruction; not a general Sturmian theory or monotile

claims.title: AHI carrier-local realization exclusions
claims.statement: For the fixed AHI source, carrier-local P17 decoding, carrier-local decoding below and at area 30, and boundary-neutral count-changing carrier states are excluded under their recorded hypotheses.
claims.scope: Exact AHI source; source macrotiles contained within finite equal-area carriers and the additional hypotheses of N60P, N64S, N65S and N68H.
claims.novelty_status: scoped architecture exclusions; external novelty not established

claims.title: AHI and Stade separable-erasure exclusions
claims.statement: Independent two-body profiles, ordinary sector stars and participant-separable torsion-free additive tests cannot realize the audited relations under their complete-contact hypotheses; the fixed Stade two-body completion also admits a periodic tiling.
claims.scope: The exact relation and contact-completeness assumptions of K61R, N61S, N62S, K69A and K70A.
claims.novelty_status: combines general classifications with source-specific applications; no universal unmarked-polygon no-go
claims.condition: N61S depends on the fixed rule table from stade-two-tiling-2025; N62S itself is source-rule-only.

claims.title: AHI parity zipper and carrier geometry ladder
claims.statement: The parity zipper, terminal erasure, bent host, outward fan and reset bounds are exact worked local geometry, but K74A/K74R show that their finite-state symbolic content is generic and they do not advance the one-support total-decoder problem.
claims.scope: K70Z through K73R and the earlier K10B/K16W/hinge carrier ladders.
claims.novelty_status: worked derivations; frozen and not a research direction

claims.title: Exact certificate and cold-verifier infrastructure
claims.statement: The repository contains reusable exact geometry, canonicalization, three-valued verdict, certificate serialization, independent cold verification and external-anchor machinery.
claims.scope: Engineering infrastructure; individual mathematical claims retain their own scopes.
claims.novelty_status: engineering asset; method novelty requires separate comparison
